_meta.viewer_consolidation: SinglePostView and Lightbox were superseded by ImageViewer with a thin ImagePage route adapter in 1.202.0. Historical rows retain their original source names; current behavioral coverage is in ui-regressions.py.
_meta.description: P3 tag-suggestion dropdown contract table — plan kura-web-componentization Step 6 (finding 2). Captured BEFORE extraction from the live implementations of the 6 ledger sites (dupe-ledger.json candidate tag-suggestion-dropdown). Each row is a testable behavioral contract; p3-interactions.py asserts every row with a real Playwright operation (row id ↔ assert label). The extraction (TagSuggestInput.svelte) must preserve every row — divergences become props, NOT a lossy merge.
_meta.shared_already: searchTags(query, limit) fetch in lib/api.ts (returns [] on !ok and on empty query — no error state ever surfaces to the UI)
global_invariants: No site has a loading indicator: dropdown appears only when results arrive.
No site has an error state: searchTags returns [] on failure → dropdown hidden.
Empty state = dropdown simply not rendered (no 'no results' row) in all sites.
Commit gesture on items is mousedown (not click) so it wins the blur race in all sites.
Highlight index range is [-1 .. len-1]; -1 = nothing highlighted; fresh results reset it to -1.
structural_deltas_accepted: BulkTagBar plain-mode roundtrip: pre-extraction, a populated suggestion list could resurrect after toggling plain→search submode (component state outlived the {#if}); post-extraction TagSuggestInput unmounts and resets. Unobservable in practice (requires switching submode with dropdown open and back); accepted.
post/[id] site is DEAD CODE (see rows P1) — resolution is deletion, not extraction.

rows.contract: oninput trims whole value as token; empty → clear immediately; else 220ms debounce → searchTags(token, 8); new results reset highlight to -1
rows.assert: type 1 token in grid ?bulk=1 input → dropdown ≤8 items appears after debounce

rows.contract: clearing the input hides the dropdown immediately (no debounce wait)
rows.assert: clear input → dropdown gone

rows.contract: ArrowDown/ArrowUp move highlight clamped to [-1, len-1], preventDefault
rows.assert: ArrowDown twice → 2nd item has .hl (was .highlighted); ArrowUp once → 1st item

rows.assert: ArrowDown+Enter → input value == picked name, dropdown closed, .chip rendered with name

rows.contract: Enter with NO highlight and non-empty input: preventDefault, commits the raw trimmed input as target (same select() path)
rows.assert: type exact tag text, Enter with highlight=-1 → .chip shows raw text

rows.contract: mousedown on an item commits it (same select() path)
rows.assert: mousedown item → chip set, dropdown closed

rows.contract: Escape closes the dropdown, input text retained; no blur
rows.assert: Escape → dropdown gone, input value unchanged, input still focused

rows.contract: blur closes the dropdown after 150ms timeout
rows.assert: focus elsewhere → dropdown gone after ~300ms

rows.contract: keydown handler calls stopPropagation() for EVERY key — page-global shortcuts never fire while typing (manga viewer: ArrowLeft/Right page nav; grid: hotkeys)

rows.contract: items show names[0] + usages, item color = catColor(category) via inline style; no loading/error/empty UI

rows.assert: type 'solo' → dropdown appears with ≤8 items

rows.contract: token containing ':' (pool:, type:, fav: qualifiers) suppresses suggestions entirely
rows.assert: type 'pool:75' → no dropdown after debounce+margin

rows.contract: committing replaces ONLY the last token, keeps preceding tokens, appends a trailing space, keeps focus, does NOT navigate
rows.assert: type 'solo gr', pick suggestion → value == 'solo <picked> ', same URL

rows.contract: a leading '-' on the last token is preserved on commit ('-<picked> ')
rows.assert: type '-gr', pick → value starts with '-' + picked name

rows.contract: keydown handler is INERT when dropdown closed (early return — no preventDefault, native caret behavior); when open ArrowDown/Up clamp highlight with preventDefault

rows.contract: Enter with NO highlight is NOT intercepted → native form submit → submit(): clears suggestions and navigates (/?q=…); Enter WITH highlight commits token instead and does not navigate
rows.assert: type 'solo', Enter (no highlight) → URL becomes /?q=solo; with highlight → URL unchanged, token replaced

rows.contract: Escape closes dropdown (only when open — handler inert when closed); no blur, no propagation guard, no preventDefault — so Chrome's NATIVE type=search Escape-clear also runs and empties the value (legacy behavior, preserved)
rows.assert: Escape with open dropdown → dropdown gone, input focused, value cleared by native search behavior

rows.contract: blur closes dropdown after 150ms
rows.assert: click elsewhere → dropdown gone

rows.contract: dropdown spans full input width (left:0 right:0), opens downward, z-index 100, max-height 220px scroll; items = name + usages, catColor colored; no loading/error/empty UI
rows.assert: dropdown width ≈ input wrapper width; item inline color style non-empty
